plain: A person who serves only for wages.

webster.text: One who is hired, or who serves for wages.

more.text: Serving for wages; venal; mercenary; employed for money or other compensation.

example.quote: Even in the midst of defensive and dangerous wars with Persia and Macedon, the members never acted in concert, and were, more or fewer of them, eternally the dupes or the hirelings of the common enemy.
example.cite: The Federalist No. 18 (Madison, with Hamilton), Dec. 7, 1787
